title: DeLonge's advisers went quiet when asked about hybrids
summary: Jason Samosa tells of DeLonge's advisers went quiet when asked about hybrids, about 2016-2017 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So De Long, when he came out, he was like, there's a big genetic component to this. And he said, I you know, I asked my advisors these questions, these questions, but the moment I asked them about hybrids, they were like, went quiet.

plain: Jason Samosa says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Tom DeLonge, a rock musician who started a public effort to reveal UFO secrets, said around 2016 and 2017 that there was a big genetic side to the phenomenon. According to Samosa, DeLonge said his advisers answered his other questions, but went quiet as soon as he asked about hybrids, meaning beings that are part human and part non-human. That silence is told as a hint that the subject was off limits.
